title: Composed three-query verifier
statement: Let $V$ be a Boolean-valued PCPP system with input length $n>0$, proof length $L$, and $r$ possible queries. Given a seedwise three-CNF reduction for $V$ with $K$ clauses per seed, there is a nonadaptive Boolean tester making three queries on an input of length $n$ and a proof of length $L+K$ times the number of possible verifier seeds. Its randomness consists of a verifier seed and a uniformly chosen clause index. It queries the three addresses corresponding to the clause's three padded literals, and accepts exactly when at least one returned Boolean answer, interpreted as a sign, equals that literal's required sign.
hypotheses_covered: $V$ is a Boolean-valued PCPP system with input length $n$
A seedwise three-CNF reduction for $V$ with parameter $K$
